references.text: The account of a woman anointing Jesus in Bethany is also found in Matthew 26:6-13, which provides a parallel to the event in Mark 14:3.
Luke 7:36-50 tells a similar story about a woman who anoints Jesus' feet, although the circumstances and details vary.
John 12:1-8 gives another version of the event where Mary, the sister of Lazarus, anoints Jesus' feet, offering insight into different perspectives on this event.
